subject: Handling warning messages in mapper function

messages.author: a46bda82d3a10fa0
messages.subject: Handling warning messages in mapper function
parts:
Hi, 

I am quite new to the hadoop world. Recently configured rHadoop and started to use qtl library function in side the mapper function and based on certain parameters sometimes there are warning messages generated by the library function which cases the crash of mapper function. 

Warning in scantwo.perm.engine(n.perm, cross=cross, phono.col = phono.col, :
Just one unique element in perm.starta, so the perms are not stratified. 
java.lang.RuntimeException: java.io.EOFException
 ….
….
…


Can someone suggest how should I handle the incoming warning from the external functions while sitting inside the mapper functions? 

Regards.
Salman.

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1247] Handling warning messages in mapper function
parts:
My guess is that the warnings are printed in standard output. I would surround any call to this qtl library with 

sink(stderr())
....
sink(NULL)

You should also report a bug to the library developers. Decade old unix conventions call for warning messages to be printed to stderr.


Antonio

messages.author: a46bda82d3a10fa0
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1247] Handling warning messages in mapper function
parts:
Hi, 

Actually the default behavior of the function call I am using is "VERBOSE=TRUE". I found it after googling for some hours in the QTL library document. After switching it to "FALSE" everything works fine. 

Having VERBOSE mode ON make sense as many strange things can happen while doing "scantwo", well suited for serial programming but for rHadoop it require special attention.  

Thanks for your reply. 

Regards..
Salman.
